findings.text: follow-on: baseline_suite.command and after_suite.command carry the literal placeholder `<the 45 files importing reckon.schedule or reckon.roadmap>` and the tests line carries `<the four updated files>`, so the suite records name no command a reader can re-run; the contract for these fields rejects an angle-bracket placeholder, and the actual file list is recoverable only from the gate logs, not from the record.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the goal is "Serve each flow bar's state, progress-anchored position, typed plan key and lane, and draw them as served"; the gained commits repair that delivery — reckon/schedule.py:26 now imports LIVE_STATES and HELD_CLASSIFICATIONS from the module that owns the pointer vocabulary and reckon/schedule.py:113-126 uses them in _bar_state, tests/spa_parity_harness.py:323 and :515 call flowLanes, the name docs/ui/crew.jsx:23 actually defines, and tests/test_the_flow_draws_each_plan_where_its_progress_puts_it.py:249-254 and :298-306 pin the served typed key and lane.
VERDICT done_when: the done-when requires every test importing reckon/schedule.py or reckon/roadmap.py and the SPA test files to show no added failure against base, with logs ending EXIT=; gate_importers_base.log (11457456d, 45 files, 505 passed, EXIT=0) and gate_importers_head.log (34ac7b6ea, 46 files, 514 passed, EXIT=0) record that population, gate_focus_repair.log records 38 passed EXIT=0 over the four updated files plus the node case file plus tests/test_surface_parity.py, and the four negative-control logs each end EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: read from the source fence (prompt.txt:69-80) and the repair round's granted scope (resume-1-advice.txt), which adds tests/spa_parity_harness.py; git diff --stat 7a83309a5..34ac7b6ea touches reckon/schedule.py, tests/spa_parity_harness.py and tests/test_the_flow_draws_each_plan_where_its_progress_puts_it.py, every one inside the granted round scope.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records commits 7a83309a5, 20745b9de and 34ac7b6ea, answers each prior finding by id (`acted f3e1b681f43: 20745b9de`, `acted reuse-phase-sets: 34ac7b6ea`, `acted docstring-versus-held-set: 34ac7b6ea`, `acted lane-assertion: 34ac7b6ea`, `acted typed-key-assertion: 34ac7b6ea`), and records the importer base/head arms, the focused arm and the three negative controls; its baseline_suite/after_suite command fields carry placeholders rather than the literal command.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 7a83309a5; 20745b9de repoints the two harness call sites flowPackLanes->flowLanes (the rename landed in docs/ui/crew.jsx:23), and 34ac7b6ea drops the local LIVE_RUN_PHASES/HELD_RUN_PHASES and imports the owner's sets plus strengthens the typed-key and lane assertions; three files, +54/-35, nothing outside the goal.
CALL_SITES: reckon/roadmap.py:1900, reckon/serve.py:1757, reckon/serve.py:1760
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the gained reckon/schedule.py:26 import and :113-126 use put the bar classification on the owning vocabulary, and tests/spa_parity_harness.py:323 restores the served-vs-drawn lane parity the goal's delivery depends on.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the done-when's importer population is recorded in logs/gate_importers_base.log (505 passed) and logs/gate_importers_head.log (514 passed), both EXIT=0, but the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite command fields name no literal command.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the three files in git diff --stat 7a83309a5..34ac7b6ea are all inside the repair round's granted scope at resume-1-advice.txt, the harness file included by that round's explicit grant.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: logs/negative_control_typed_key.log reddens at tests/test_the_flow_draws_each_plan_where_its_progress_puts_it.py:251 when the typed key reverts to the bare slug and logs/negative_control_lane_assertion.log reddens at :298 when the packer ignores its fit test, so each repaired assertion is shown to fail on the regression it names.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/schedule.py:26 takes the sets from the module that owns them and no added name, comment or docstring carries a plan or ticket label in the gained commits.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the gained diff adds no definition; reckon/schedule.py:26 extends the owner reckon/sprint_liveness.py:37/42 rather than re-spelling it, which retires the earlier duplication, and the test reuses reckon/resources.py:190 nav_key.
FINDING manifest.md:27 follow-on: baseline_suite.command and after_suite.command carry the literal placeholder `<the 45 files importing reckon.schedule or reckon.roadmap>` and the tests line carries `<the four updated files>`, so the suite records name no command a reader can re-run, which the contract for these fields forbids.
